title: On the Feasibility, Costs, and Benefits of an Imme- diate Phasedown of Coal for U.S. Electricity Generation
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Regularization from Economic Constraints: A New Estimator for Marginal Emissions
abstract: Environmental policy is increasingly concerned with measuring emissions resulting from local changes to electricity consumption. These marginal emissions are challenging to measure because electricity grids encompass multiple locations and the information available to identify the effect of each location's consumption on grid-wide emissions is limited. We formalize this as a highdimensional aggregation problem: The effect of electricity consumption on emissions can be estimated precisely for each electricity generating unit (generator), but not precisely enough to obtain reliable estimates of marginal emissions by summing these effects across all generators in a grid. We study how two economic constraints can address this problem: electricity supply equals demand and an assumption of monotonicity. We show that these constraints can be used to formulate a 'naturally regularized' estimator, which implements an implicit penalization that does not need to be directly tuned. Under an additional assumption of sparsity, we show that our new estimator solves the high-dimensional aggregation problem, i.e., it is consistent for marginal emissions where the usual regression estimator would not be. We also develop an asymptotically valid method for inference to accompany our estimator. When applied to the U.S. electricity grid with 13 separate consumption regions, our method yields plausible patterns of marginal generation across fuel types and geographic location. Our estimates of region-level marginal emissions are precise, account for imports/exports between regions, and allow for all fuel types to potentially be on the margin.
abstract_zh: 环境政策日益关注由电力消费的局部变化所引起的排放。边际排放难以测量，因为电网涉及多个地点，而可用于识别每个地点用电对全网排放影响的信息十分有限。我们将此问题表述为一个高维加总问题：用电对排放的影响可以在每台发电机组（发电机）层面上得到精确估计，但若将这些影响在电网中所有发电机上加总，其精度不足以得到可靠的边际排放估计。我们研究了两个经济约束如何解决这一问题：电力供给等于需求，以及单调性假设。我们证明，这些约束可用于构造一个“自然正则化”估计量，该估计量隐含了一种无需直接调节的隐式惩罚。在额外的稀疏性假设下，我们证明，这一新估计量能够解决高维加总问题，即它对于普通回归估计量所无法一致估计的边际排放，能够给出一致估计。我们还开发了一种渐近有效的推断方法，与该估计量配套使用。将该方法应用于划分为13个独立用电区域的美国电网时，我们得到了在燃料类型和地理位置上合理的边际发电模式。我们对区域层面边际排放的估计精确，考虑了区域间的进出口，并允许所有燃料类型都有可能处于边际位置。

title: Why Service Quality Alone Doesn't Open the Tap on Rate Hikes: Assessing the Determinants of Willingness to Pay for Drinking Water Infras- tructure
Electrification in the Long Run
Optimal subsidies for green hydrogen generation
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists

title: Can Bitcoin Mining Increase Renewable Electricity Capacity?
abstract: Proponents of Bitcoin argue that demand for electricity from Bitcoin miners can lead to an increase in renewable electricity capacity. We rigorously evaluate this claim by estimating a Bitcoin electricity demand curve and include this demand curve in a long-run model of the Texas electricity market. We find that while Bitcoin mining can indeed increase renewable capacity, it also increases carbon emissions. When Bitcoin miners provide grid management services in the form of demand response, their emissions impact is largely mitigated.
abstract_zh: 比特币支持者认为，比特币矿工对电力的需求可以带动可再生电力装机容量的增长。我们通过估计比特币电力需求曲线，并将该需求曲线纳入德克萨斯州电力市场的长期模型，严格检验了这一主张。我们发现，尽管比特币挖矿确实可以增加可再生能源装机容量，但它同时也会增加碳排放。当比特币矿工以需求响应的形式提供电网管理服务时，其排放影响在很大程度上得以缓解。

title: U.S. West Coast Droughts and Heat Waves Exacerbate Pollution Inequality and Can Undermine Emissions Control Policies
abstract: Droughts reduce hydropower production and heatwaves increase electricity demand, forcing power system operators to rely more on fossil fuel power plants. However, less is known about how droughts and heat waves impact the county level distribution of health damages from power plant emissions. Using California as a case study, we simulate emissions from power plants under a 500-year synthetic weather ensemble. We find that human health damages are highest in hot, dry years. Counties with a majority of people of color and counties with high pollution burden (which are somewhat overlapping) are disproportionately impacted by increased emissions from power plants during droughts and heat waves. Taxing power plant operations based on each plant’s contribution to health damages significantly reduces average exposure. However, emissions taxes do not reduce air pollution damages on the worst polluting days, because supply scarcity (caused by severe heat waves) forces system operators to use every power plant available to avoid causing a blackout.
abstract_zh: 干旱会减少水电产量，热浪会增加电力需求，迫使电力系统运营商更多地依赖化石燃料发电厂。然而，对于干旱和热浪如何影响发电厂排放所造成的健康损害在县级层面的分布，人们了解得较少。我们以加利福尼亚州为案例，在500年的合成气象集合下模拟了发电厂的排放。我们发现，人类健康损害在炎热干燥的年份最为严重。以有色人种为多数的县，以及污染负担较高的县（二者在一定程度上有所重叠），在干旱和热浪期间，受发电厂排放增加的影响尤为严重。根据每座发电厂对健康损害的贡献来对其运营征税，可显著降低平均暴露水平。然而，排放税并不能减少污染最严重日子的空气污染损害，因为供应短缺（由严重热浪导致）迫使系统运营商动用每一座可用的发电厂，以避免停电。

title: Why marginal CO2 emissions are not decreasing for U.S. electricity: Estimates and implications for climate policy
venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

title: Expected health effects of reduced air pollution from COVID-19 social distancing
abstract: The COVID-19 pandemic resulted in stay-at-home policies and other social distancing behaviors in the United States in spring of 2020. This paper examines the impact that these actions had on emissions and expected health effects through reduced personal vehicle travel and electricity consumption. Using daily cell phone mobility data for each U.S. county, we find that vehicle travel dropped about 40% by mid-April across the nation. States that imposed stay-at-home policies before March 28 decreased travel slightly more than other states, but travel in all states decreased significantly. Using data on hourly electricity consumption by electricity region (e.g., balancing authority), we find that electricity consumption fell about 6% on average by mid-April with substantial heterogeneity. Given these decreases in travel and electricity use, we estimate the county-level expected improvements in air quality, and, therefore, expected declines in mortality. Overall, we estimate that, for a month of social distancing, the expected premature deaths due to air pollution from personal vehicle travel and electricity consumption declined by approximately 360 deaths, or about 25% of the baseline 1500 deaths. In addition, we estimate that CO2 emissions from these sources fell by 46 million metric tons (a reduction of approximately 19%) over the same time frame.
abstract_zh: 2020年春季，COVID-19疫情在美国催生了居家令及其他保持社交距离的措施。本文考察了这些行动通过减少私家车出行和用电，对排放及预期健康影响产生的作用。利用美国每个县的每日手机移动数据，我们发现，到4月中旬，全国车辆出行量下降了约40%。在3月28日之前实施居家政策的州，其出行量下降幅度略大于其他州，但所有州的出行量都显著下降。利用各电力区域（如平衡管理机构）的每小时用电数据，我们发现，到4月中旬，用电量平均下降约6%，且存在显著的异质性。鉴于出行和用电量的下降，我们估计了县级层面空气质量的预期改善，从而估计了预期死亡率的下降。总体而言，我们估计，在一个月的社交隔离期间，由私家车出行和用电造成的空气污染导致的预期过早死亡减少了约360人，约占基准1500例死亡的25%。此外，我们估计，在同一时期，这些来源的CO2排放减少了4600万公吨（约减少19%）。

title: Heterogeneous responses to price: Evidence from residential water consumers
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management

title: Measuring the environmental benefits from trans- portation electrification: Urban electric buses
The electric vehicle transition and the economics of banning gasoline vehicles
abstract: Electric vehicles have a unique potential to transform personal transportation. We analyze the transition to electric vehicles with a dynamic model that captures the falling costs of producing electric vehicles, the decreasing pollution from electricity generation, the increasing substitutability of electric for gasoline vehicles, and the durability of the vehicle stock. Due to the external costs from pollution, inefficiencies under business as usual result from the mix of vehicles as well as the transition timing, the severity of which depends on substitutability. We calibrate the model to the US market and find the magnitude of the inefficiency is rather modest: less than 5 percent of total external costs. The optimal purchase subsidy for electric vehicles and the optimal ban on the production of gasoline vehicles both give about the same efficiency improvement, but the latter leads to a sharp increase in gasoline vehicle production just before the ban. Phasing out gasoline vehicles with a bankable production quota reduces deadweight loss substantially more than the other policies, but may lead to a very large deadweight loss if set incorrectly.
abstract_zh: 电动汽车在改变个人交通方面具有独特的潜力。我们利用一个动态模型分析向电动汽车的过渡，该模型刻画了电动汽车生产成本的下降、发电污染的减少、电动汽车对汽油车替代性的增强，以及车辆存量的耐用性。由于污染造成的外部成本，在照常发展的情况下，车辆结构以及过渡时机都会导致效率损失，其严重程度取决于替代性。我们以美国市场对模型进行校准，发现效率损失的幅度相当有限：不到总外部成本的5%。电动汽车的最优购置补贴与禁止生产汽油车的最优禁令，带来的效率改进大致相同，但后者会导致在禁令实施前汽油车产量急剧增加。以可存储的生产配额逐步淘汰汽油车，比其他政策更大幅度地减少了无谓损失，但如果设定不当，可能导致非常大的无谓损失。

title: Decompositions and policy consequences of an extraordinary decline in air pollution from electricity generation
abstract: Using integrated assessment models, we calculate the economic value of the extraordinary decline in emissions from US power plants. Annual local and global air pollution damages fell from $245 to $133 billion over 2010–2017. Decomposition shows changes in emission rates and generation shares among coal and gas plants account for more of this decline than changes in renewable generation, electricity consumption, and damage valuations. Econometrically estimated marginal damages declined in the East from 8.6 to 6 cents per kWh. Marginal damages increased slightly in the West and Texas. These estimates indicate electric vehicles are now cleaner on average than gasoline vehicles. (JEL H23, L94, Q53, Q58)
abstract_zh: 利用综合评估模型，我们计算了美国发电厂排放异常大幅下降所带来的经济价值。2010至2017年间，年度地方和全球空气污染损害从2450亿美元下降至1330亿美元。分解结果表明，煤电和气电之间排放率及发电份额的变化，所解释的下降幅度大于可再生能源发电、电力消费和损害估值变化所解释的部分。经计量估计，东部的边际损害由每千瓦时8.6美分下降至6美分。西部和得克萨斯州的边际损害则略有上升。这些估计表明，电动汽车现在平均比汽油车更清洁。（JEL H23, L94, Q53, Q58）

title: Integrating physical and financial approaches to manage environmental financial risk on the Great Lakes
abstract: Physical and financial approaches each provide different benefits for managing environmental financial risks. Index insurance contracts, a financial approach, have been proposed for managing numerous environmental financial risks. A method for testing when and how physical (dredging) and financial risk management strategies (index insurance) could be deployed in tandem to maximize improvements in utility for commercial shippers on the Great Lakes is developed using principles from the benefit‐cost analysis and expected utility theory. Using a utility function with a decreasing marginal utility of income explicitly models the risk aversion of commercial shippers. The probabilistic nature of future revenue and costs is modeled and combined with the utility function to determine a Net Option Value. This value represents the maximum amount commercial shippers would pay more than the cost for reduced variability in net revenues. Results indicate that while the Net Option Value for dredging exceeds the potential benefits of using insurance contracts alone, the combination of dredging and insurance can improve overall utility with less cost than dredging alone. The strong autocorrelation in lake levels over long periods reduces the value of index insurance, such that the results show a potential lower bound of the value of combining physical and financial approaches in highly variable systems.
abstract_zh: 物理方法与金融方法各自为管理环境财务风险提供了不同的益处。指数保险合约作为一种金融方法，已被提议用于管理多种环境财务风险。本文基于效益-成本分析和期望效用理论，提出了一种方法，用以检验物理（疏浚）与金融风险管理策略（指数保险）在何时以及如何搭配使用，才能最大限度地提高五大湖商业托运人的效用。我们采用边际收入效用递减的效用函数，明确刻画了商业托运人的风险厌恶。未来收入与成本的概率性质被建模，并与效用函数相结合，以确定净期权价值。该价值代表商业托运人为降低净收入的波动性而愿意额外支付的最高金额，超出成本的部分。结果表明，虽然疏浚的净期权价值超过了仅使用保险合约的潜在收益，但疏浚与保险相结合，能够以低于单独疏浚的成本提高总体效用。湖泊水位在长时期内的强自相关性降低了指数保险的价值，因此，结果显示了在高度多变的系统中，物理与金融方法相结合的价值下界。

title: Distributional effects of air pollution from electric vehicle adoption
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental and Resource Economists
abstract: We examine distributional effects of changes in local air pollution from driving electric vehicles in the United States. An econometric model estimates power plant emissions and an integrated assessment model values damages in air pollution from electric and gasoline vehicles. Using data on currently registered electric vehicles, we find that people in census block groups with median income greater than about $65,000 receive positive environmental benefits while those below this threshold receive negative environmental benefits. On average, Asian and Hispanic residents receive positive environmental benefits, but white and black residents receive negative environmental benefits. In multivariate analyses with census region fixed effects, environmental benefits are positively correlated with income and urban measures and with Asian, black, and Hispanic block-group population shares. Created environmental benefits tend to be larger in states offering purchase subsidies. However, for these states, an increase in subsidy size is associated with a decrease in environmental benefits.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了美国驾驶电动汽车所引起的本地空气污染变化的分配效应。一个计量经济模型估算了发电厂排放，一个综合评估模型则对电动汽车和燃油汽车所造成的空气污染损害进行了估值。利用现有注册电动汽车的数据，我们发现，中位收入超过约6.5万美元的人口普查街区组居民获得了正的环境收益，而收入低于该门槛的居民则承受了负的环境收益。平均而言，亚裔和西班牙裔居民获得正的环境收益，而白人和黑人居民则承受负的环境收益。在包含人口普查区域固定效应的多变量分析中，环境收益与收入、城市化指标以及亚裔、黑人和西班牙裔的街区组人口占比呈正相关。在提供购车补贴的州，所创造的环境收益往往更大。然而，对于这些州而言，补贴金额的增加却与环境收益的减少相关。

title: Understanding water utility at- titudes toward water transfers and risk: Pre-test results
venue: Journal of Water Resources Planning and Management

title: Optimal regulation of pollution with stochastic exposure, acute damages, and chronic damages
Are there environmental benefits from driving electric vehicles? The importance of local factors
Damages and expected deaths due to excess NOx emissions from 2009-2015 Volkswagen diesel vehicles
Optimal trading ratios for pollution permit markets
Terminating links between emission trading programs
venue: Journal of Environmental Economics and Management
abstract: Compliance links between CO2 emission trading programs--where firms regulated under one region's tradable permit program can comply using permits from another region, and vice-versa--are beginning to arise as a vehicle to lower costs, increase liquidity, and strengthen institutions while achieving the same environmental outcome. These links are not immutable, however, as highlighted by New Jersey's decision to exit the multi-state Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative at the end of 2011.This raises the question of how to manage a delink and, in particular, what to do with existing permits that are banked for future use--choices that can have important consequences for market behavior in advance of, or upon speculation about, a delinking event. To examine this question, we consider two delinking policies. One differentiates banked permits by origin, where banked permits originating in one region are only valid for compliance in that region after the delink occurs. The other treats all banked permits the same, with each banked permit being similarly split into two pieces, with one piece valid in one region and the other piece valid in the other region. Using a two-region, two-period model, we describe the price behavior and relative cost-effectiveness of each policy. Treating permits differently generally leads to higher costs, and may lead regional prices to diverge, even when there is only speculation about delinking. We illustrate these results with a numerical example of the EU-Australian link contemplated in 2013.
abstract_zh: 二氧化碳排放交易项目之间的合规关联正在出现，即一地区可排放许可证项目下受监管的企业，可以使用另一地区的许可证来履行合规义务，反之亦然。这一机制作为一种途径，能够在实现相同环境结果的同时降低成本、增加流动性并加强制度建设。然而，这些关联并非一成不变，新泽西州于2011年底退出多州区域温室气体行动（RGGI）就是明证。这就提出了如何管理脱钩，尤其是如何处理已存入银行以备未来使用的现有许可证的问题——这些选择可能对脱钩事件发生之前，或对脱钩事件的预期出现时的市场行为产生重要影响。为考察这一问题，我们研究了两种脱钩政策。一种是按来源区分存储许可证，即源自某一地区的存储许可证，在脱钩发生后只能在该地区用于合规。另一种则对所有存储许可证一视同仁，将每张存储许可证同样拆分为两份，一份在一个地区有效，另一份在另一个地区有效。我们利用一个两区域、两期模型，描述了每种政策下的价格行为及相对成本效益。区别对待许可证通常会导致更高的成本，并可能使区域价格发生分化，即使仅仅是对脱钩的预期也会如此。我们以2013年曾被考虑的欧盟—澳大利亚关联为例，用数值算例说明了这些结果。

title: Bilateral oligopoly in pollution permit markets: exper- imental evidence
Optimal advanced credit releases in ecosystem service markets
Optimizing the scale of markets for water quality trading
abstract: Applying market approaches to environmental regulations requires establishing a spatial scale for trading. Spatially large markets usually increase opportunities for abatement cost savings but increase the potential for pollution damages (hot spots), vice versa for spatially small markets. We develop a coupled hydrologic‐economic modeling approach for application to point source emissions trading by a large number of sources and apply this approach to the wastewater treatment plants (WWTPs) within the watershed of the second largest estuary in the U.S. We consider two different administrative structures that govern the trade of emission permits: one‐for‐one trading (the number of permits required for each unit of emission is the same for every WWTP) and trading ratios (the number of permits required for each unit of emissions varies across WWTP). Results show that water quality regulators should allow trading to occur at the river basin scale as an appropriate first‐step policy, as is being done in a limited number of cases via compliance associations. Larger spatial scales may be needed under conditions of increased abatement costs. The optimal scale of the market is generally the same regardless of whether one‐for‐one trading or trading ratios are employed.
abstract_zh: 将市场手段应用于环境监管，需要确定交易的空间尺度。空间范围较大的市场通常能增加减排成本节约的机会，但也增加了污染损害（热点）的可能性；空间范围较小的市场则相反。我们开发了一种耦合水文-经济模型方法，用于大量点源排放者之间的排放权交易，并将该方法应用于美国第二大河口流域内的污水处理厂（WWTP）。我们考虑了两种管理许可证交易的行政结构：一对一交易（每单位排放所需的许可证数量对所有污水处理厂都相同）和交易比率（每单位排放所需的许可证数量因污水处理厂而异）。结果表明，水质监管机构应允许在河流流域尺度上进行交易，作为一种适当的初步政策，目前已有少数案例通过合规协会实现了这一做法。在减排成本增加的条件下，可能需要更大的空间尺度。无论采用一对一交易还是交易比率，市场的最优尺度通常是相同的。

title: Best-of-three Contest Experiments: Strategic versus Psycho- logical Momentum
Market power, private information, and the optimal scale in pollution permit markets with application to North Carolina's Neuse River
abstract: We extend the analysis of optimal scale in pollution permit markets by allowing for both market power and private information. We characterize the total costs (abatement costs and damages) under market power and private information and compare them to total costs under competition. It is possible for both market power and private information to lead to lower total costs than competition, but generally the differences between the three market structures will be small. We also conduct an optimal scale analysis of nitrogen pollution from Waste Water Treatment Plants (WWTP) into North Carolina's Neuse River System. An economic model of damages and abatement costs is integrated with a hydro-ecological model of nitrogen flow through the Neuse. We determine the optimal number of trading zones and allocate the WWTP into these zones. Under the most likely regulatory scenario, we find cost savings of 1.55 million dollars per year under the optimal market design relative to the typical 303 (d) regulation in which the WWTP are not allowed to trade.
abstract_zh: 我们将污染许可证市场最优规模的分析加以拓展，同时考虑市场势力与私人信息。我们刻画了在市场势力和私人信息条件下的总成本（减排成本与损害），并将其与竞争条件下的总成本进行比较。市场势力和私人信息都有可能使总成本低于竞争情形，但一般而言，三种市场结构之间的差异较小。我们还对北卡罗来纳州纽斯河水系（Neuse River）中污水处理厂排放的氮污染进行了最优规模分析。我们将损害与减排成本的经济模型，与纽斯河氮流动的水文生态模型相结合。我们确定了最优的交易区数量，并将污水处理厂分配到这些区域中。在最可能的监管情景下，我们发现，与污水处理厂不允许交易的典型303(d)条款监管相比，最优市场设计每年可节省155万美元成本。

title: On a Fundamental Advantage of Permits over Taxes for the Control of Pollution
abstract: We extend the tax versus permits literature by considering permit supply functions and pollution tax functions that are generalizations of the usual constant permit supply and constant pollution tax rate. In our model, pollution is not uniformly mixed and the regulator is uncertain about the polluting firms' abatement costs. We determine the optimal permit supply functions and the optimal pollution tax functions. Using these functions, we show that permits lead unambiguously to lower total expected costs than taxes. We analyze the magnitude of this difference for a simple model of climate change. By relating the optimal permit supply functions to Weitzman~(1978) we provide a new interpretation of his results.
abstract_zh: 我们对税收与许可证之争的文献进行了拓展，考虑了许可证供给函数和污染税函数，它们分别是通常的固定许可证供给和固定污染税率的一般化形式。在我们的模型中，污染并非均匀混合，且监管者对污染企业的减排成本存在不确定性。我们确定了最优许可证供给函数和最优污染税函数。利用这些函数，我们证明，许可证制度所带来的总预期成本明确低于税收制度。我们以一个简单的气候变化模型分析了这一差异的大小。通过将最优许可证供给函数与Weitzman（1978）的研究联系起来，我们对其结果提供了新的解释。

title: Should Consumers be Priced Out of Pollution Permit Markets?
Decentralization in Pollution Permit Markets
abstract: A pollution permit market is decentralized when firms are allowed to trade permits across time, regions or pollutants. Using a model in which firms have better information about their abatement costs than a regulator, we develop a comparative advantage formula that delineates whether or not pollution permit markets should be decentralized. When the damage from pollution is described by a separable function, the formula implies a simple sufficient condition for not allowing decentralization.
abstract_zh: 当允许企业跨时间、跨地区或跨污染物交易许可证时，污染许可证市场便是分散化的。利用一个企业比监管者更清楚自身减排成本的模型，我们提出了一个比较优势公式，用以界定污染许可证市场是否应当分散化。当污染损害由可分离函数描述时，该公式给出一个简单的充分条件，据此可判定不应允许分散化。
